item.title: Why the total solar eclipse appeared golden
item.description: Spain's total solar eclipse showed a golden corona instead of the usual white, due to the Sun's low angle at sunset.

item.title: SpaceX rocket crash on Moon reveals new crater
item.description: A discarded Falcon 9 stage hit the Moon on Aug. 5, creating a 60-foot crater, confirmed by NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter.

item.title: Diamond crushed under extreme pressure solves 20-year mystery
item.description: Experiments revealed how diamond behaves under pressures exceeding those inside Neptune and Uranus, resolving a long-standing conflict in scientific understanding.

item.title: Schizophrenia linked to widespread synapse loss, especially on left side
item.description: Specialized brain scans show schizophrenia is associated with extensive loss of synapses connecting brain cells, with a notable pattern on the left side of the brain.
